answers.rationale: For a short, no-car family museum weekend with a timed Saturday entry, Maya repeatedly prioritizes the most convenient, better-reviewed central hotel over modest breakfast savings. Monument Center is only about $3 more than Market Square across the three-night stay including breakfast, while improving the rating to 4.6 and shortening the museum walk to five minutes. It also beats the included-breakfast Franklin option on rating, nightly total, and walk time.

All four options have the same four-night room-plus-daily-breakfast total of $1,044. Harbor Exchange is therefore the clear leader: it has the highest guest rating (4.6), the shortest walk for the early client sessions (five minutes), and an on-site restaurant. This matches Maya's repeated work-trip preference for shorter, more reliable early-morning commutes and easy dinner access over included breakfast alone.
